answers.moment: When I mentioned the Open University course and said it was something I never finished, she picked up on it and asked what I meant. I explained about leaving uni and she said she thought it was really brave.
answers.reason: I don't usually bring that up with people I've just met, so I was a bit surprised I said it. I sort of expected a polite nod, not her saying that. It's something I feel a bit funny about, so it stuck.
